title: Argentinian Vibrant Tofu Bake
description: A fusion of Argentine flavors with a vibrant twist using vibrant vegetables. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: vibrant
ingredients.amount: 2 cups ( mixed bell peppers, carrots, zucchini)

ingredients.name: Argentinian seasoning blend
ingredients.notes: such as paprika, oregano, and cumin

ingredients.name: bake potatoes
ingredients.notes: washed and pierced with a fork

instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place tofu cubes on the baking sheet, drizzle with 1 tbsp of olive oil, and sprinkle with Argentinian seasoning blend.
Toss the vibrant vegetables, onion, and garlic with the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil on a separate baking sheet.
Bake the tofu and vegetables for 25-30 minutes, or until the tofu is golden brown and the vegetables are tender.
Meanwhile, bake the potatoes for 45-50 minutes, or until they are cooked through.
Serve the tofu and vegetables with baked potatoes on the side.
